summary.text: Sensory Injury is Shen Shang's human path killer move. It strikes through an Immortal Gu House that was not built to block human path.

claims.text: After Fang Yuan tries to locate him in the dark, Shen Shang activates the killer move Sensory Injury. Fang Yuan is hit at once and realizes it is a human path killer move; Myriad Year Flying Warship could not guard against it. Immortal Gu Houses give offense, defense, and a large measure of safety, but that defense is not perfect. When Fang Yuan designed Myriad Year Flying Warship he considered most paths, yet human path was his weakness and he was not a human path grandmaster then; by the time he gained that attainment the house was already built, so he could only adjust it a little, with no major modifications. He also lacked defensive human path Immortal Gu. After the hit, he concludes that Shen Shang has a high rank human path Immortal Gu.

When Shen Shang later passes cultivation experience, killer moves, and Immortal Gu recipes to Shen Cong Sheng, he says that with heal injury Immortal Gu as the foundation he developed and created saving dead healing injuries, light injuries, heavy injuries, fatal injuries, sensory injuries, seven laborious injuries, and other killer moves.
